summary: Hard-async event deraining: published mechanisms for asynchronous spatial context, benchmarked against our measured pyramid ladder
result:
# Final Report: Per-Event Oriented Multi-Scale Context — Literature Verdict, Chosen Falsifier, and the Hard-Async Decision

All accuracy numbers labeled "ours" are event-BA on held-out scene 4, scene-disjoint, exact per-event labels, real EVK4 rain, per-frame mean-score threshold — the same protocol at every rung. Citation flags: **[V]** = verified against primary full text this scan; **[V-abs]** = verified at abstract/metadata level only; **[2H]** = second-hand number, never read from its primary source; **[U]** = unverified.

---

## 1. Can oriented multi-scale context be maintained per-event?

**No published mechanism does it at accuracy that survives real dense data.** Four independent screens (hierarchical surfaces, async networks, in-sensor compute, streaming point-cloud) converge on the same triangulation: every system on record has at most two of the three required properties — {A2 clock-freedom, oriented context, survives real dense data} — and the missing third is different in each family.

| Mechanism | True async level | Context type | Real-data accuracy | Power |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| HATS [V, arXiv:1803.07913] | A0 (decision window-clocked; τ=10⁹ µs makes it a normalized count map, not timing) | count map, spatially resolved, single-scale | 0.902 acc / 0.945 AUC N-CARS | not reported |
| HOTS [V via HATS Table 2] | A2 repr., windowed decision | oriented-capable prototypes, multi-scale | **0.568 AUC N-CARS — collapse** | not reported |
| HFirst | pure A2 | **oriented multi-scale (Gabor S1/C1)** | **0.408 AUC / 56.1% — below chance at ranking** | not reported |
| ELiSeD | genuine A2 | oriented (level-line angle) | author-measured collapse at 500 Kev/s, below EVK4 rain rates (3–8 Meps) | not reported |
| SILC [V-abs, arXiv:1903.11332] | genuine A2, 1.6 Mev/s/core | rank-normalized local patch (our measured-dead family, AUC 0.5068) | reprojection table [2H] | not reported |
| DART | A0; windowed decision | oriented wedges but positions-as-counts, r≤10 px | — | not reported |
| FEAST | A0+A1 features, windowed classifier | 121 px whole-patch = saturated-local | 26–80 Kev/s | not reported |
| AsyNet [V-framing] | A0/A1; window is the clock; slower than dense (80.4 vs 23.4 ms) | oriented multi-scale (= dense trunk by equivalence) | = dense parent | not reported |
| AEGNN [V-abs, arXiv:2203.17149] | A0/A1; two hidden clocks (init pass, K=10 subsample rate) | oriented (spline geometry), hop-local | 0.163 vs 0.40 mAP Gen1 — never closes to dense | not reported |
| EvGNN [V, arXiv:2404.19489] | **A2, hardware-proven** | count-like in effect (≤16 frozen-feature neighbors) | 87.8% INT8 N-CARS | **305 nJ/ev (28 nm ASIC projection, not silicon)** |
| EventFormer [venue V via dblp; numbers 2H via FARSE-CNN Table 1] | A0 with arrival-order micro-batch clock; per-event A1 never shown | learned global memory, not oriented | 0.848 N-Caltech101 **[2H — never read from primary]** | not reported |
| FARSE-CNN [existence V via dblp/repo; numbers U, paywalled] | A2 on paper (GPU-batched in practice) | learned multi-scale per-cell LSTM | 0.687 vs dense 0.817 [U] | not reported |
| MLPF [V, arXiv:2304.07543] | true A2-capable | strictly-local timestamp patch (our 0.5068 class) | shot-noise task only | **4 nJ/ev (65 nm ASIC estimate)** |
| Scheerlinck 2019 [V, arXiv:1812.00438] | **true A2** | **oriented (Sobel/structure-tensor ODE states)** | **zero accuracy/throughput/power numbers exist**; pyramid is one unexecuted sentence; default α=2π rad/s ≈ 160 ms, 10× slower than our 5–10 ms info floor | not reported |
| luvHarris [V, arXiv:2105.11443] | A0+A1 around a resource-clocked **dense** Harris pass | oriented, computed densely | +40% precision vs eHarris; 8.59 Mev/s event thread | not reported |
| Camuñas-Mesa 2011 [V-abs; 200 mW figure U] | **genuine A2 silicon** (self-timed AER conv) | **oriented** — but single-scale 32×32 | — | 200 mW [U] |
| Speck [V, Nature Comms 2024] | **genuine A2 silicon** | oriented, learned, 9 layers | **no absolute accuracy anywhere in the paper**; 100 M SynOps/s ceiling → 14× under-provisioned for raw storm ingest (ours) | **0.42–9.5 mW, measured silicon** |
| DAGr / Dampfhoffer 2025 | not A2 by design (20 Hz frames / deliberate clocked branch) | oriented, clocked-in | authors concede pure-async caps accuracy | not reported |

The void is exact: **oriented + A2 exists (Scheerlinck, Camuñas-Mesa, ELiSeD, HFirst) but is single-scale, number-free, throughput-dead, or accuracy-dead; multi-scale + accurate exists (AsyNet, AEGNN, EvGNN, trunk hybrids) but always contains a clock or a count-like effective state.** The intersection — per-event recursive oriented multi-scale state with measured classification accuracy against a dense baseline — is unclaimed in the published record (confirmed by arXiv prior-art search: one dense/windowed SLAM use of structure tensors on time surfaces; zero recursive per-event uses).

Power scoreboard: of ~19 papers screened, exactly three carry any power number (EvGNN 305 nJ/ev projected; MLPF 4 nJ/ev estimated; Speck 3.8–9.5 mW measured). The field's low-power premise is almost entirely unmeasured; our power case must come from ops/event accounting, and the two silicon-class datapoints show **the A2 power budget was never the blocker — oriented context transport without a clock is.**

---

## 2. The async accuracy ladder, extended

Placement basis: cross-dataset accuracies do not transfer numerically; mechanisms are placed by **context class** (strictly-local / count / oriented-single-layer / learned composition), which is the variable our ladder measures directly and which predicted every real-data outcome in the screens.

| Rung (event-BA, ours) | Our measurement | Published mechanisms at this rung | Basis |
|---|---|---|---|
| 0.500 chance | — | HFirst (0.408 AUC — below chance at ranking) | measured, N-CARS |
| 0.5055 (AUC 0.5068) | strictly-local 3×3 patch | MLPF, SILC-patch class, AEDNet's affinity core | identical statistic class: local timestamp/rank patch |
| 0.57–0.64 | 3×3 polarity counts 0.6362 | HOTS (0.568 AUC); density-filter lineage (BAF, DROR, M-of-N: at chance on real storms, AUC 0.7265 only on synthetic sparse rain — ours) | measured; premise failure (rain is the 5–8× dense, self-correlated majority — ours) |
| 0.68–0.69 **count saturation** | +4 px 0.6800; +16 px **0.6888**; +64 px 0.6850 | FARSE-CNN (0.687 vs dense 0.817 on its own benchmark [U]); EvGNN effective context; FEAST; DART; Khodamoradi BAF | count-class state saturates here regardless of scale (measured); EvGNN's ≤16 frozen neighbors = support statistic |
| 0.69–0.74 **untested band** | — | **nobody** — HATS-map pyramid (L1), Scheerlinck ODE pyramid, ELiSeD angle half, EigenPyramid all live here untested | this band is empty in the literature; that emptiness is the finding |
| 0.8299 dense-context hybrids | window-clocked trunk + per-event head | AsyNet (= dense by equivalence), DAGr, Dampfhoffer, luvHarris pattern — every one clocked | measured (ours); every published system at this accuracy has a clock (all four screens concur) |
| >dense | — | EventFormer 0.848 [2H — the single most strategically important number in the scans and the one nobody has read from its primary source] | flagged, unaudited, saccade-painted static scenes; prior: does not transfer to correlated clutter |

The ~0.14 between count saturation and the trunk is held by oriented multi-scale **composition** (log-Gabor bank + 129 px gates — ours), not orientation per se (trunk ablation: removing orientation costs only −0.0082, KITTI, ours). In every measured instance across five years and three architecture families, that 0.14 was bought with a clock.

---

## 3. The chosen falsifier

**Unanimous judge consensus: EigenPyramid (LEAD, both judges)** — per-event structure-tensor pyramid with exponential forgetting. CIDER-SNN: BACKUP, sequenced after (run only if EigenPyramid dies of isotropy; pre-filter with the linear pool-probe first). StormGate: rejected as a scan entry (it is the measured 0.8299 hybrid with the clock renamed); its 13 ms staleness check runs as deployment insurance only.

**Spec (single-core CPU, our labeled EVK4 data):**

- **Pre-filter (one afternoon, free kill):** regress the trunk's log-Gabor channel responses from the 19 candidate columns on already-extracted features. R² ≈ 0 kills the entire second-moment branch before any head training.
- **State:** per tile, per scale s ∈ {4, 16, 64 px}: decayed mass w, mean μ, second moment S (3 floats), timestamp T — 7 floats = 28 B/tile; ~1.7 MB total.
- **Update (A0, lazy decay, no clock anywhere):** d = exp(−Δt/τ_s) via 256-entry LUT; NDT-OM weighted-covariance recursion with forgetting (Saarinen et al., IJRR 2013 — recursion published, system scan-clocked); ~12 flops + 1 LUT per scale, one tile touched per scale.
- **Read (A1, per event):** closed-form 2×2 eigen → per scale: coherence (λ1−λ2)/(λ1+λ2), (cos 2θ, sin 2θ), log-spread-per-mass, minor-axis residual of this event; plus 4 cross-scale gates (orientation agreement, coherence ratios — mandatory per the HFirst lesson). 19 columns, all homogeneous degree-zero in event mass — the HATS h_C/|C| normalization (Sironi 2018 [V]) applied one moment order higher, dividing out the 5–8× density confound algebraically.
- **Protocol:** append to the exact 0.6888 feature set; same logreg head; train scenes-minus-4; evaluate scene 4; τ swept {5, 10, 20, 40 ms} (respecting the 5–10 ms floor; Scheerlinck's default is 10× too slow). Report orientation-bin-conditioned accuracy as the event-generation-bias control.
- **Cost:** ~150 ops/event on top of the 96-MAC head; MLPF-class silicon envelope (~10 nJ/ev class by ops accounting — our estimate, not a citation).
- **KILL NUMBER: best-τ event-BA ≤ 0.7088** (< +0.02 over 0.6888).
- **Hours: pre-filter one afternoon; main pass hours on one core; ≤ 2 CPU-days total.** Full three-branch program ~3 CPU-days, ordered so each pre-filter (log-Gabor R², 13 ms staleness check, linear pool-probe) can kill its branch before its main experiment runs.

Dominant risk (both judges): **isotropy collapse** — inside a 4–16 px tile a dense storm is an orientation mixture that drives the 2×2 tensor toward isotropy exactly as superposition saturated counts, one moment order higher; and at τ near the info floor the 4 px tensor averages a handful of events. The falsifier is shaped so this dies in one cheap, decisive, branch-closing experiment.

---

## 4. The hard-async verdict

**What A2 honestly achieves today on real dense rain: ~0.69, the count-saturation ceiling.** Every genuinely clock-free mechanism with real-data numbers carries count-class or strictly-local context (EvGNN-in-effect 87.8% on a toy clip benchmark, MLPF, BAF); every A2 mechanism carrying oriented context is either accuracy-dead on real data (HFirst 0.408, HOTS 0.568), throughput-dead at rain rates (ELiSeD at 500 Kev/s), or number-free (Scheerlinck). No exception exists in ~19 screened papers.

**The price of the alternative is measured and small.** The duty-scaled hybrid holds 0.8299 at 5.69 ms dense pass per 104 ms window with exact 6.5 ms ring-buffer sliding (~150 Hz refresh, microsecond A1 assignment — ours); amortized dense cost during a storm is ~3–15 nJ/event (our ops accounting on an edge-NPU estimate) — 20–100× **below** the only true-A2 learned silicon (EvGNN, 305 nJ/ev projected), while beating it by ≥0.13 in accuracy-class. AsyNet's own γ→2 bound [V-framing] predicts sparse-incremental loses to clocked-dense exactly when the input is dense and self-correlated — which real rain is by construction (ours: 5–8×, self-correlated); the L4 γ box-count formalizes this on our scenes in one afternoon.

**Disposition: hard-async is a section, not the paper claim, and not yet retired.**
- *Not a claim:* nothing published or built clears 0.71 at A2; claiming hard-async would rest entirely on an experiment not yet run.
- *A section:* the measured negative is publishable as-is — the empty 0.69–0.74 band, the HFirst/HOTS counter-examples, the power scoreboard (3 numbers in 19 papers, all showing power was never the blocker), and the unclaimed-composition finding.
- *Retirement is conditional:* if EigenPyramid ≤ 0.7088 **and** the log-Gabor R² is near zero **and** γ ≈ 2 on our scenes, hard-A2 pursuit of trunk-class context is formally closed and the ring-buffer hybrid is the provable efficiency frontier. If EigenPyramid clears 0.72+, the section becomes a result: the first per-event oriented multi-scale statistic to beat count saturation on real rain.

---

## 5. Honest assessment

**Probabilities** (judge-anchored: both judges put EigenPyramid at "roughly even odds," expected 0.70–0.72 at best τ):

| Outcome | P |
|---|---|
| Log-Gabor R² pre-filter kills EigenPyramid for free | 0.25 |
| EigenPyramid clears kill bar (>0.7088) | 0.40–0.45 |
| EigenPyramid ≥ 0.72 (clearly publishable positive rung) | 0.20–0.25 |
| EigenPyramid ≥ 0.75 | ≤ 0.10 |
| CIDER-SNN Stage-1 clears 0.6988 (run only on EigenPyramid isotropy-death) | 0.30; post-spiking ≥ 0.75: ≤ 0.15 (FARSE-CNN 0.687-vs-0.817 precedent [U]) |
| StormGate staleness kill (a) survives | ~0.9, but near-tautological under storm rates (judge 2: validates a scheduler, not a mechanism) |
| StormGate ≥2× duty reduction on our rain-dominated corpus | ~0.4 |

**Enters the current paper now (all measured, no pending experiments):**
1. The full ladder (0.500 → 0.5055 → 0.6362 → 0.6888 saturation → 0.6850 → 0.8299) with per-rung ops/event.
2. The negative results: strictly-local heads at chance (AUC 0.5068); density-filter lineage at chance on real storms vs 0.7265 on synthetic sparse rain; counting-hash noise; per-frame self-prior failure (corr 0.39); no coherent rain velocity; 5–10 ms information floor.
3. The literature finding: no published mechanism maintains oriented multi-scale context per-event; the two true-A2 oriented systems are precisely the two that collapse on real data (HFirst 0.408, HOTS 0.568); 16 of 19 papers report no power; every dense-accuracy system contains a clock. Flag EventFormer 0.848 as second-hand and FARSE-CNN's numbers as repo-consistent but not re-read.
4. The 0.8299 duty-scaled hybrid with exact 6.5 ms ring-buffer sliding as the current operating point, with ops-accounted per-event power against the two silicon anchors (MLPF 4 nJ/ev [V], EvGNN 305 nJ/ev [V, projection]).

**Enters only after the falsifier:** any EigenPyramid rung (positive or the branch-closing negative), the γ box-count closure argument, per-tile operating-point realization (+0.08 oracle fraction, in progress), and any hard-async framing stronger than "open question with one cheap unrun experiment" — which is, as of today, exactly what it is.
